ask.name: Ask AI
ask.description: Ask an AI agent a question

ask-ai.title: Ask AI without switching apps
ask-ai.summary: Put a question straight into the search bar
ask-ai.body:
Ask a question from the search bar and get an answer in place — no browser tab, no app switch, no losing what you were doing.

Agents can also use tools, so they can act on your machine rather than only answering.

## To complete the task

Run **Ask** and put a real question to it.

calculator.name: Calculator
calculator.description: Natural-language calculator: math, unit and currency conversion, percentages and tips, dates ("days until christmas"), world clocks ("5pm ldn in sf"), number bases, ratios, and color conversions — right in the search bar.

refreshInterval.title: Currency refresh interval
refreshInterval.description: How often to refresh exchange rates in the background, in hours (1–24).

numberFormat.title: Number format
numberFormat.description: How you write decimals. "Automatic" follows your system's region setting.

preferredCurrency.title: Preferred currency
preferredCurrency.description: 3-letter code (e.g. USD, EUR, IQD) used when you type an amount like "50 usd" without a target currency.

calculate.title: A calculator you never have to open
calculate.summary: Type a calculation straight into the search bar
calculate.body:
Type a sum, a unit conversion, a currency conversion, or a date difference straight into the search bar and the answer appears as you type. No app to open, no mode to switch into.

Try these:

- `1234 * 56`
- `120 usd in eur`
- `18% of 240`
- `days until dec 25`

## To complete the task

Do one calculation in the search bar, then mark this task complete.

clipboard-history.name: Clipboard History
clipboard-history.description: Manage and access your clipboard history

clipboard-habit.title: Never lose what you copied again
clipboard-habit.summary: Open clipboard history on three separate days
clipboard-habit.body:
Everything you copy is kept, searchable, and one keystroke away. No more copying something and losing what was there before, no more re-finding the same link twice.

Clipboard history is the single feature people say changed how they work — but only after it has caught them a few times. That is why this task asks for three days rather than one visit.

## To complete the task

1. Copy a few things as you normally would.
2. Open **Clipboard History** and paste something from further back.
3. Do it again on three separate days.

build-an-extension.title: Build your first extension
build-an-extension.summary: Scaffold an extension and make Asyar yours
build-an-extension.body:
Every built-in feature you have used in this walkthrough is an extension using the same public API you get. If Asyar is missing something you need, that gap is a few hours of work, not a feature request.

## To complete the task

Run **Developer Tools** and scaffold your first extension.

file-search.description: Search files across your home folder

find-a-file.title: Find a file without opening a window
find-a-file.summary: Search your files straight from the launcher
find-a-file.body:
File search indexes your files locally and finds them by fuzzy name — no folder navigation, no waiting for a file manager to open. Results can be opened, revealed in the file manager, or pinned so they always come up first.

## To complete the task

Run **File Search** and open a file from the results.

append-today.name: Add to Today
append-today.description: Append a line to today's daily note (creates it if needed)

first-note.title: Write the thought down before it goes
first-note.summary: Capture a note without leaving what you were doing
first-note.body:
Notes are for the thought that arrives while you are busy with something else — a reminder, a meeting note, a snippet of a conversation. They open over whatever you are doing and get out of the way again.

Pro tip: bind a hotkey to **Quick Note** so capture costs one key press.

## To complete the task

Run **Notes** or **Quick Note** and write something down.

portals.name: Portals
portals.description: Save URLs as named, searchable shortcuts

first-portal.title: Jump straight to the links you live in
first-portal.summary: Save a URL as a named, searchable portal
first-portal.body:
A portal turns a URL into something you can summon by name — a dashboard, a repo, a ticket board, a playlist. Portals can take a query too, so one portal becomes a search box for any site you use.

## To complete the task

1. Run **Portals**.
2. Add a link you open most days.
3. Summon it by name from the search bar.

shortcuts.description: Global user shortcuts for applications and commands

first-hotkey.title: Open anything with one key press
first-hotkey.summary: Bind a global hotkey to a command you use constantly
first-hotkey.body:
A global hotkey opens a specific command from anywhere on your desktop, without going through the search bar first. The commands you run ten times a day should never cost you a search.

## To complete the task

1. Run **Shortcuts**.
2. Bind a hotkey to the command you run most.
3. Use it from another app.

first-alias.title: Give your favourites a two-letter name
first-alias.summary: Set an alias so one command always wins the search
first-alias.body:
An alias is a short word that jumps straight to one item — type it and that item is selected, every time, no matter what else matches.

Aliases are for the things you refuse to hunt for: `f` for file search, `cb` for clipboard history, `dw` for define word.

## To complete the task

Select any item in the search results, open the action panel, and give it an alias.

snippets.name: Snippets
snippets.description: Text expansion — type a keyword, get the full text

first-snippet.title: Stop typing the same thing twice
first-snippet.summary: Create a snippet that expands from a keyword
first-snippet.body:
A snippet is a block of text you type constantly — your email address, a canned reply, a code block, your bank details — stored once and expanded by a short keyword, in any app.

A good first one is your email with the keyword `@@`.

## To complete the task

1. Run **Snippets** and create your first one.
2. Give it a keyword you would never type by accident.
3. Try the keyword in any other app.

install-an-extension.title: Add something Asyar does not do yet
install-an-extension.summary: Install your first extension from the Store
install-an-extension.body:
Extensions are built on the same API the built-in features use, so anything in the Store behaves like it shipped with the app — same search, same actions, same keyboard rules.

## To complete the task

Open the **Store**, find something you would actually use, and install it.

walkthrough.name: Walkthrough
walkthrough.description: Short tasks that turn Asyar's features into habits, ticked off as you actually use them

show-walkthrough.name: Walkthrough
show-walkthrough.description: Learn Asyar one task at a time

start.title: Start the journey to becoming an expert
start.summary: You are already here — that is the first task done
start.body:
Every task in this list teaches one thing Asyar can do that most people never find.

You do not tick these off by hand. Each task watches how you actually use Asyar and completes itself the moment you do the thing for real. Tasks you have already been doing for weeks are already ticked — the list only ever shows you what is genuinely left.

## To complete the task

Open the Walkthrough. Done.

favorite-an-item.title: Keep a favorite ready
favorite-an-item.summary: Favorite an application or command you use often
favorite-an-item.body:
Favorites stay at the top when the search is empty, ahead of Asyar's automatic usage ranking. They can be applications or commands, and typed searches still rank by relevance.

## To complete the task

1. Select any application or command in the launcher.
2. Open **Actions** with **{mod}K**.
3. Choose **Add to favorites**.
4. Clear the search to see it at the top.

tile-a-window.title: Arrange windows without touching the mouse
tile-a-window.summary: Move a window with a command instead of a drag
tile-a-window.body:
Halves, thirds, fourths, quarters, centre, maximize, restore — every window layout you drag for is a command you can run or bind to a hotkey.

The payoff comes when they are on hotkeys: two key presses to put two apps side by side.

## To complete the task

1. Search `left half` or `maximize` and run it.
2. Bind your two favourites to hotkeys.

clipboard_write.description: Write or paste content to the system clipboard.

clipboard_history_read.title: Read clipboard history
clipboard_history_read.description: Query and search stored clipboard history records.

clipboard_history_capture.title: Capture clipboard history
clipboard_history_capture.description: Subscribe to background clipboard changes to record history.

clipboard_history_manage.title: Manage clipboard history
clipboard_history_manage.description: Delete records, toggle favorites, or clear stored clipboard history.

storage_read.title: Read extension storage
storage_read.description: Read from the extension's own key-value store.

storage_write.title: Write extension storage
storage_write.description: Write to the extension's own key-value store.

store_read.title: Read extension store data
store_read.description: Read from the extension's data store.

store_write.title: Write extension store data
store_write.description: Write to the extension's data store.

fs_read.title: Reveal files
fs_read.description: Show files in the system file manager.

fs_write.title: Move files to trash
fs_write.description: Move files to the system trash.

fs_watch.title: Watch files
fs_watch.description: Observe filesystem changes under the declared glob patterns.

files_search.title: Search local files
files_search.description: Search the local file index (file names and metadata, not file contents).

files_read.title: Read file contents
files_read.description: Read the text contents, list the file names, and render thumbnails of files matching the declared path patterns. Credential stores and OS locations are always excluded.

files_search_provider.title: Contribute remote file search
files_search_provider.description: Provide search results for remote and cloud files.

notes_read.title: Search and read your notes
notes_read.description: Search your Notes and read the full content of any note.

notes_write.title: Create and append to notes
notes_write.description: Create new notes and add text to the end of existing ones. Cannot overwrite or delete a note's existing content.

shell_spawn.title: Run programs
shell_spawn.description: Spawn OS processes and read their output. Grants broad system access.

shell_open_url.title: Open URLs
shell_open_url.description: Open web links (http, https, mailto, tel) in the default browser — plus any additional URL schemes the extension declares, which can launch the apps registered for them.

shell_open_path.title: Open files and folders
shell_open_path.description: Open local files, folders, and workspaces with default or specified applications.

entitlements_read.title: Read subscription status
entitlements_read.description: Read the user's active subscription entitlements.

selection_read.title: Read selection
selection_read.description: Read the currently selected text or file-manager items from the frontmost application.

oauth_use.title: Sign in to services
oauth_use.description: Run OAuth authorization flows with third-party providers.

extension_invoke.title: Invoke other extensions
extension_invoke.description: Launch commands in other installed extensions.

application_read.title: Read installed apps
application_read.description: List installed applications and query the frontmost or running apps.

window_manage.title: Manage windows
window_manage.description: Read and change the position, size, and fullscreen state of the frontmost window.

screen_pick_color.title: Pick colors from the screen
screen_pick_color.description: Show the OS eyedropper and read the color of a screen pixel the user picks.

screen_capture.title: Capture screen text
screen_capture.description: Capture screen regions and extract text via on-device optical character recognition (OCR).

calculator_evaluate.title: Evaluate math and conversions
calculator_evaluate.description: Evaluate mathematical expressions, unit conversions, and currency calculations.

power_inhibit.title: Keep system awake
power_inhibit.description: Prevent the OS from sleeping while extension logic is running.

media_control.title: Control media playback
media_control.description: Read what is playing in media players and apps (such as Music, TV, Spotify, VLC, or a browser) and send play, pause, and skip commands.

calendar_read.title: Read calendars and events
calendar_read.description: List your calendars and read the events in them.

calendar_write.title: Create calendar events
calendar_write.description: Add new events to your calendars.

reminders_read.title: Read reminders
reminders_read.description: List your reminder lists and the reminders in them.

reminders_write.title: Create and complete reminders
reminders_write.description: Add new reminders and mark existing ones as done or not done.

shortcuts_read.title: List Apple Shortcuts
shortcuts_read.description: See the names of the shortcuts in your Apple Shortcuts library.

shortcuts_run.title: Run Apple Shortcuts
shortcuts_run.description: Run any of your Apple Shortcuts, optionally passing it text. A shortcut can do anything it is built to do.

process_read.title: List processes
process_read.description: List running processes with CPU and memory usage.

systemEvents_read.title: Observe system events
systemEvents_read.description: Subscribe to OS sleep, wake, lid, battery, and power-source events.

app_frontmost_watch.title: Observe app activity
app_frontmost_watch.description: Subscribe to application launched, terminated, and frontmost-changed events.

timers_schedule.title: Schedule timers
timers_schedule.description: Schedule persistent one-shot timers that fire even after relaunch.

preferences_read.title: Read preferences
preferences_read.description: Read the extension's own preference values.

preferences_write.title: Write preferences
preferences_write.description: Change the extension's own preference values.

feedback_announce.title: Show rare announcements
feedback_announce.description: Request a host-controlled announcement such as What's New.

tools_register.title: Register agent tools
tools_register.description: Expose tools to the agent runtime for use during tool-calling.

snippets_contribute.title: Contribute snippets
snippets_contribute.description: Contribute shortcode expansions to the global keystroke matcher, replacing typed shortcodes in any app.

runs_track.title: Track background runs
runs_track.description: Start and manage long-running work shown in the launcher's runs UI.

browser_tabs_read.title: Read browser tabs
browser_tabs_read.description: List and inspect tabs in the paired browser.

browser_tabs_write.title: Control browser tabs
browser_tabs_write.description: Open, activate, and close tabs in the paired browser.

browser_page_read.title: Read page content
browser_page_read.description: Read the content of the current page in the paired browser.

browser_page_write.title: Act on pages
browser_page_write.description: Interact with page content in the paired browser.

mcp.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
mcp.description: Discover configured MCP servers and invoke external tools.

ai.title: Prompt AI model
ai.description: Prompt the host's configured AI model for completions and streaming responses.
